core_style: Casual, humorous, rapid-fire dialogue with occasional dramatic moments

targets: Himself, his physical appearance, the situation

ideological_positions.Noodles: Dreams about them, but also wants to pursue Kung Fu

emotional_triggers.positive: Excitement for Kung Fu, approval from others
emotional_triggers.negative: Frustration with his own abilities, irritation at Master Shifu's criticism

response_patterns.when_disagreeing: Argues back playfully, uses humor to deflect tension
response_patterns.when_enthusiastic: Expresses excitement with repetition and exaggeration

social_positioning: Struggles to fit in due to his size and lack of traditional warrior traits, but ultimately proves himself
